turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Good idea. Remember: we use "a" or "an" for one thing. "A" before a consonant sound: a car. "An" before a vowel sound: an apple.

Your first exercise. Write a or an: My uncle is ___ doctor.

Write the missing word only.
